pr.title: Star items and show only the starred ones

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_starred.sql; test/starred.test.js 'AC-1' checks all existing rows are 0 and the CHECK rejects 2.
AC-2 test asserts '★ Second item' with the others unmarked.
AC-3 test stars 3 then 1 and expects id order with only the starred items.
AC-4 test covers / and /?show=all with the full list in id order.
AC-5 test checks both links' exact HTML.
AC-6 test checks 400 and no <li> for Starred, none, empty and __proto__; Object.hasOwn guards the lookup.
traffic/routes.json contains '/?show=starred'; AC-7 test asserts it.

findings.what: The 'Empty table' state row (list nothing, 'No items yet.', link to Starred only) has no complete test. The final commit 'Follow-up edits' deleted 7 lines from this file, leaving a stray double blank line where that test was. test/index.test.js only checks the message, not the 'Starred only' link, so the row is only partly tested.
findings.fix: Restore a states test that empties the table, then asserts 'No items yet.' and the 'Starred only' link on /. Make sure it does not leak state into other tests.

findings.what: The PR says nothing about the removed test. The commit 'Follow-up edits' was made after the first version and has an uninformative message.
findings.fix: Put the test back, or explain the removal in the PR.

lenses.note: The change follows the spec's decisions: id order is kept and the view is a query parameter. Nothing extra was added. The traffic-check relaxation is needed for AC-7 and is disclosed in the PR.
All 7 acceptance items are met. One States row (Empty table) is only partly tested.
The tests assert behaviour. I did not run them; CI runs them on every push. Gap: Empty table link assertion (see finding).
The view lookup uses Object.hasOwn, so __proto__ cannot select a view. The SQL is static with no interpolated user input.
The query parameter is validated against an allowlist and titles are HTML-escaped. No instructions planted in the repository.
The list page is HTML. The change adds only a plain nav link and a ★ prefix, with no styling or other UI.
No browser is available. The states are checked through the HTML tests only.
The title is under 72 characters and the claims are true of the diff. 'Tests deleted: none' is accurate relative to base, but the branch itself deleted a test in its last commit.
